en: I'm the diving treasure hunter! I'm the fellow who dives to the bottom of the sea for the treasures lying there.
Tell me, have you come across any shards? Pieces of tools from long, long ago?
No treasure for me, huh... If you find a shard, like a Red Shard, you've got to trade it with me!
Hey! That's a shard! I'm looking for those! Trade it to me, and I'll give you something good!
What do you want to trade?
Your Red Shard for my Fire Stone, then?
Your Yellow Shard for my Thunder Stone, then?
Your Blue Shard for my Water Stone, then?
Your Green Shard for my Leaf Stone, then?
It's a deal! Use it wisely!
Huh? You haven't got one of those. Come back when you've found one!
No? That's a shame. Well, come back if you change your mind.
